annotation.title_clean: Advanced robotics in injection-moulded and extruded plastic products manufacturer reducing physical demanding tasks (ID13)
annotation.title_en: Advanced robotics in injection-moulded and extruded plastic products manufacturer reducing physical demanding tasks (ID13)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: EU-OSHA (European Agency for Safety and Health at Work)
annotation.summary_en: EU-OSHA publication page for a 4-page case study of a Swedish plastics manufacturer using operator-controlled cobots for sample preparation. The cobot reduces repetitive strain and contamination risk, frees workers for complex tasks, and specialist health and safety checks add protection.
key_provisions_or_claims: Cobots automate monotonous sample preparation, reducing musculoskeletal disorder risk.
Operator-controlled cobot improves time efficiency and lowers contamination risk.
Workers are freed for more challenging tasks.
Specialist health and safety checks of the system add protection.
